data.text: Release 0.12.0 did not publish: npm publish runs the suite, and the new timeline perf case failed on the release runner — both pages and a calendar fold under one 50 ms, measured 52.1 ms (27–35 ms on the PR runs, 15 ms locally; the runner was ~3x slower across the board, cold start 85 ms vs 26). Nothing reached npm; no GitHub release was made. Fixed in the test, not the code: one page per measure at 50 ms each, the rule the cfd/flow page case already uses. Adding a size check found the timeline page at 546 KB for 1,100 rows; bounded at 1 MB as a growth detector, the calendar at 500 KB like cfd.
